name: Thakurgaon
shortDesc: Explore the historic Ramrai Dighi, the legendary Surjapuri Mango Tree, and experience authentic rural life in northern Bangladesh's agricultural heartland.
description: A district shaped by ancient ponds, legendary mango trees, and a community that has preserved its agricultural heritage for generations.
knownFor: Mangoes, paddy, Ramrai Dighi, Surjapuri heritage

experiences.title: Ramrai Dighi Heritage Walk
experiences.desc: A guided walk around the centuries-old pond with local historians. Learn about Mughal-era water management, the pond's role during 1971, and the ecology of the surrounding area.

experiences.title: Surjapuri Orchard Visit
experiences.desc: Visit the legendary Surjapuri mango tree and surrounding orchards. Seasonal mango tasting sessions with local farming families who preserve heritage cultivars.

experiences.title: Community Homestay
experiences.desc: Stay with a local family in Thakurgaon's eco-village homestay program. Experience rural Bangladeshi life — from morning farming routines to evening meals cooked with homegrown ingredients.

experiences.title: Agricultural Immersion
experiences.desc: Join local farmers for a day in the fields. From paddy transplantation to vegetable harvesting, experience the agricultural rhythms that define Thakurgaon's identity.

name: Panchagarh
shortDesc: Stand at Banglabandha Zero Point, walk through organic tea estates, and discover geological stones from the Himalayas at the Rocks Museum.
description: Stand at the northernmost point of a nation, walk through organic tea estates that rival Darjeeling, and hold geological stones older than human civilization.
knownFor: Banglabandha Zero Point, tea gardens, Rocks Museum, Himalayan views
ecoModel: Tea estate tours, geological tours, homestays, border tourism

experiences.title: Banglabandha Zero Point
experiences.desc: Stand at the northernmost tip of Bangladesh. On clear winter days, the snow-capped peaks of Kanchenjunga (8,586m) are visible. Guided border walks and visitor interpretation center.

experiences.title: Kazi & Kazi Tea Estate Tour
experiences.desc: Walk through organic tea gardens, participate in tea tasting sessions, tour the processing factory, and meet the indigenous tea garden workers.

experiences.title: Rocks Museum & River Walk
experiences.desc: Explore the geological museum housing Himalayan stones, then join a guided stone-hunting walk along the riverbeds.

experiences.title: Indigenous Community Visit
experiences.desc: Meet the Santal indigenous communities and learn about their agricultural practices, festivals, and oral traditions.

name: Dinajpur
shortDesc: Visit the magnificent Kantaji Terracotta Temple, experience ESDO's model eco-villages, and discover the cultural richness of northern Bengal.
description: A district where centuries-old terracotta temples stand alongside living eco-villages — Dinajpur is where Bangladesh's cultural heritage meets sustainable development.
upazilas: 13 (Sadar, Birampur, Birganj, Biral, Bochaganj, Chirirbandar, Phulbari, Ghoraghat, Hakimpur, Kaharole, Khansama, Nawabganj, Parbatipur)
knownFor: Kantaji Temple, terracotta architecture, eco-villages, lychee orchards
ecoModel: Heritage tourism, eco-village homestays, cultural immersion

experiences.title: Kantaji Terracotta Temple
experiences.desc: Visit one of South Asia's finest examples of Hindu temple architecture. The 18th-century temple features intricate terracotta panels depicting scenes from the Ramayana, Mahabharata, and daily rural life.

experiences.title: ESDO Eco-Village Stay
experiences.desc: Experience ESDO's model eco-village — a community designed around sustainable living, organic farming, and environmental conservation. Participate in daily activities and learn about the eco-village concept.

experiences.title: Cultural Heritage Walk
experiences.desc: Explore Dinajpur's old town with a local guide — visiting Rajbari (palace ruins), colonial-era buildings, and the district museum.

experiences.title: Organic Farm Experience
experiences.desc: Join local farmers for organic lychee, mango, and vegetable cultivation. Learn about permaculture techniques used in ESDO's eco-villages.
